name: Canaan Valley Resort State Park
notes: WV. Chairlift launch ~300 ft S of top of Ski Lift A (coords: Paragliding Earth #21300). Direction window is the 45-degree cross rule; speed 0-15 from club page (min not confirmed). Park allows gusts to 20; using the stricter P3 limit of 18. Not confirmed with the club.

name: Richmond Dale
notes: OH. Ridge/thermal launch facing SW; tight sloped takeoff surrounded by trees (Paragliding Earth #7343). Ohio Flyers membership needed for gate key. PGE: needs very specific wind speed and direction; not a beginner site. Wind criteria unknown.

name: Wes-Mar Airfield
notes: OH. Grass runway, scooter towing for paragliders (Paragliding Earth #13558); PGE lists NE/E and SW/W runway directions. Ohio Flyers membership needed. Towing criteria differ from launch sites; wind criteria unknown.
